name: XAUUSD_DQR_QUALITY_REVERSAL_V1
title: Daily Quality Reversal (DQR) - Liquidity Sweep + D1 Level + Momentum Confirmation
spec_source: user discretionary brief, STEP 1-3 verbatim; STEP 4+ agent-designed (truncated spec)

step_1_levels.pdh_pdl: prior D1 high and prior D1 low
step_1_levels.swings: confirmed D1 swing highs/lows, fractal left=2 right=2 (right bars required => no look-ahead)
step_1_levels.touches: swing levels with >= 2 historical touches within 0.30*ATR
step_1_levels.availability_rule: a level defined by D1 bar k is usable only at d1.ts[k] + 1 day, i.e. after that bar has closed

step_2_sweep.long: exec low < level - tolerance AND close > level
step_2_sweep.short: exec high > level + tolerance AND close < level
step_2_sweep.note: no single sweep definition is preselected; all three are reported

step_3_rejection.long: bullish body AND close_position >= close_pos_min AND close back above level
step_3_rejection.short: bearish body AND (1-close_position) >= close_pos_min AND close back below level

step_4plus_agent_designed.momentum_confirmation: the bar immediately after the sweep bar is impulsive in the trade direction: |body| >= impulse_atr * ATR and close beyond the sweep bar's far side
step_4plus_agent_designed.decisive_break_rule: if any of the last break_lookback closed bars closed decisively beyond the level by break_atr*ATR, the level is treated as BROKEN and the setup is skipped (spec item 6)
step_4plus_agent_designed.entry: open of the bar after the confirmation bar closes
step_4plus_agent_designed.target: fixed R multiple (rr), not the next level
step_4plus_agent_designed.exit: stop / target / max_holding_bars, intrabar, closer level wins ties
step_4plus_agent_designed.cooldown: no new entry within cooldown_bars of the previous entry; same-level re-use blocked for 10 bars

costs.note: actual per-bar DB spread is used when available

anti_lookahead: levels gated by known_from = defining D1 bar close
sweep + confirmation evaluated on closed execution bars only
entry at the open of the bar AFTER the confirmation bar
features built on the full series then sliced by TIME, never sliced before building
honesty_note: This is a hypothesis under test, not a validated strategy. Mean-reversion-at-level is the same family as the already-rejected V3/V4/V7. No parameter was chosen to make the backtest look good.
